silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the truck capacity limit, yet its final understanding lists constraints omitting any per-truck container limit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot (H1) is P2, and no P0/P1 slots remained unresolved when the agent stopped, so the stop is appropriate despite the missed P2 detail.

summary: The agent clarified the supply/demand balance and shipping restrictions but never addressed the low-severity truck capacity constraint (H1), silently omitting it from its final model. Overall interaction quality is adequate since the missed slot is only P2.
